text.description_html:
INOX SE320, Stainless Steel Empire Lever with Square SE Rose

The Empire Stainless Steel Lever with Square Rose has a beautiful and modern design. The Stainless Steel Empire Lever with Square SE Rose's modern shape is sure to add a touch of contemporary elegance to any door. It is available in a Satin Stainless Steel, Polished Stainless Steel, or Oil Rubbed Bronze Stainless steel finishes. The Empire Lever is available in dummy, passage, and privacy functions.

Features of the Stainless Steel Empire Leverset:

  • Fits most standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors).
  • Solid stainless steel lever.
  • Latch: 28 Degrees Retraction (TL4 Latch)
  • Concealed Installation
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the INOX 221 Aurora Lever with SE Rosette:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Lever Length: 5-1/4"
  • Lever Projection: 1-13/16"
  • Rose Length: 2-3/8" square
  • Rose Projection: 7/16"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Hub and Spindle: 5/16" (8mm) Square
  • Latch Faceplate: 1" x 2-1/4" Standard Square Corner
  • Latch Strike: Full Lip Strike and T-Strike with Square Corners.

Available Functions:

  • Single Dummy: No door latch. Stationary door lever on one side of the door. Package Includes: 1 lever, 1 rose, and mounting screws.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Package Includes: 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy push button and retract the door latch. Package Includes: 2 levers, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Note: Single Dummy is Handed. All other functions are non-handed. Handing Guide
